title: 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB1RE: the round rule of the digit list, proved for every chamber
text: Each visit works on the tape right of the rightmost wall (a run of 1s): blocks 1 (01)^(n+1) are swept to 1 (11)^n 00 and back, the wall loses three 1s and the last block grows. Lean proves the round for every list of blocks, in both right-end regimes and at a wall of three 1s; checked against the run it predicts 3,607 of 4,145 visits exactly. The rest meet a leftover 100, which rebuilds walls and has no rule yet.
